text.tspan: store · allow-list gate · fold · sync driver

div.p: Built today: the transport.Transport seam is cut, with HTTP/SSE registered as transport #1; one relay (cairnd) with a pinned keypair, allow-list, invites, and a directory; browser runs a parallel TS port. Next: LAN/BLE/Meshtastic behind the same interface, pubkey-addressed routing, symmetric node-to-node sync, and relay-to-relay bridging with interest-based routing. Later: the browser becomes a Go-WASM node (retiring the TS port). Browsers never do BLE/mesh — they reach the mesh through a permanent or mobile node.

g.text: full peer — signs, folds, syncs offline
